label: Damage types
description: What a hit does. 'Strong vs', 'weak vs' and 'no effect on' are typed links to what the target is (armour class, nature, armour model, target type). They drive the generator's counter hints and are relative, not numbers. On a researched unit, pick a weapon's type with the steps under armament[].damage in docs/fields.md.

terms.label: Explosive
terms.description: Blast and shrapnel with an area effect. Good against groups and structures.

terms.label: Fire
terms.description: Burns over time and can leave burning ground.

terms.label: Electric
terms.description: Shocks that can chain between targets; especially hard on drones and electronics.

terms.label: Energy
terms.description: Lasers, plasma and prism light. Precise and good at burning through plating.

terms.label: Cryo
terms.description: Little damage by itself: it slows, then freezes. A frozen target takes heavy bonus damage from the next hit (shatter), so it is a setup for teammates.

terms.label: Sonic
terms.description: Concussive waves that pass through targets and push them back.

terms.label: Toxic
terms.description: Gas, acid, radiation or nanites. Lingers as a zone; sealed vehicles resist it.

terms.label: EMP
terms.description: Little or no damage: it stops vehicles and drones from moving, firing or both, and knocks out energy shields, for a time.

terms.label: Melee
terms.description: Blades, claws and bites up close.

terms.label: Repair
terms.description: Restores health to friendly units instead of harming enemies.
